result.description: Conceptual tabletop audio sculpture designed for ambient room art installations and interactive soundscapes. The Nebula Loom N4-7 combines a passive resin shell, capacitive touch controls, and a small dual-driver speaker array tuned for soft loop playback rather than high-volume output. It includes Bluetooth LE pairing, USB-C power, and a companion app for scheduling tones, all packaged in a matte ceramic-gray enclosure intended for studios, galleries, and reception spaces.
result.title: Nebula Loom N4-7
